metadata.hypothesis_title: Thalamocortical Hyperarousal and Morphology Modulate White Matter Integrity and Slow-Wave Generation in Insomnia

critic_findings.message: The primary test for thalamus_DMN_FC and salience_FC did not reach statistical significance (p=0.246), while the test for thalamus_DMN_FC and frontoparietal_FC was significant (p=0.010). This mixed result suggests partial support for the hypothesis.
critic_findings.recommendation: Consider using linear regression with additional covariates to improve model accuracy and address potential confounding factors.
